list: eval/businesses-3.json (12 Turkish online shops from a sales prospect list, never used before; most queries are the bare name with no city or domain, on purpose: the hardest input)
checkedBy: Independent re-check outside Proofline on 2026-10-12: curl (HTTP/HTTPS, page titles, full homepage HTML, Instagram links), openssl s_client (certificate end date), Nominatim free-text search limited to Turkey, direct domain probes, the prospect list's own record of each shop's website (Saker, 9-11 Oct), web search.

hilalav.no_own_website: wrong: hilalavmarket.com is its own shop (title 'Av Tüfekleri I Kamp & Outdoor', IdeaSoft store; the prospect list records this domain). Search showed only Yandex Maps, and the address built from the name was not tried
hilalav.not_on_map: right (no Hilal AV Market on OSM in Turkey)

erenhobi.https_healthy: right (certificate ends 15 Dec 2026 = 64 days; http 307 to https)
erenhobi.phone_unconfirmed: right as stated (0312 447 04 49 from listings is not on the site; the site shows 0541 311 56 54)
erenhobi.possibly_renamed: wrong: the page title is just the address 'erenhobi.com'; 'erenhobi' and 'Eren Hobi' are the same name without the space. Nothing was renamed

petankara.on_map: wrong: the match 'Ankara Pet' (Lizbon Caddesi, Ata Mah.) is another pet shop; Pet Ankara is at İşçi Blokları Mah. 1516. Cadde 37/4, Çankaya (its contact page). Same two words in the other order, one of them the city

aktifim.no_own_website: wrong: the business ('Aktifim Kozmetik') sells on kozmetikvagonu.com (prospect list record). The name alone could not lead there, but the claim is false

markapia.not_on_map: right (online-only shop; markapia.com was not found by the run, but no claim was made about it)

lostmind.no_own_website: unverifiable: the prospect list ('Lost Mind Studios') measured a web store's mobile speed, so a site likely exists, but its address is not recorded and no search found it; lostmind.com is a parked GoDaddy page

tokerbebe.not_on_map: right (no Toker Bebe on OSM; the store is in Mamak, Ankara per its site)

tubabutik.not_on_map: unverifiable: OSM has a clothes shop named 'Tuba' in Fatih, İstanbul; nothing ties it to tubabutik.com (an ikas store with no address on the homepage)

shout.site_online: wrong business: shout-tv.com is 'Shout! TV' (a US streaming service), not the Turkish clothing shop shout.com.tr

loky.site_online: wrong business: lokyai.com is 'Loky AI' (data infrastructure), not the Turkish shop
loky.on_map: wrong business: a village in Madagascar

osepet.no_own_website: right (sells on shopier.com/osepet per the prospect list; osepet.com is a domain-for-sale page)

modalila.no_own_website: unverifiable: the shop sells on shopier.com/modalilacomm; modalila.com is a separate-looking tesettür store ('Modalila') with no link to that Shopier page or an Instagram handle, so it may or may not be the same business

aktifim.possibly_renamed: rightly dropped: aktiv.com has nothing to do with Aktifim

missed.markapia: own site markapia.com not found (planner picked no domain)
missed.petankara: own site petankara.com.tr not found (planner picked no domain)
missed.shout: own site shout.com.tr not found; a foreign namesake was taken instead
